Level 3 - Intermediate30 minSOLID: LArcesiumAmazon

Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP)

Learn why "a square is a rectangle" is true in maths but false in code, the exact rules a subtype must follow (preconditions, postconditions, invariants), how to fix Rectangle/Square and Bird/Penguin, and how to catch LSP bugs with contract tests.
